edicionMujer.title: The Collection
edicionMujer.description: The story of a woman designing for other women, a timelessness Fely Campo now brings, for the first time, to Prêt-à-porter.

cuadriculaTabs.descripcion: Pieces designed to accompany you through every celebration, from the ceremony to the last dance of the night.

visitaAtelier.texto: Discover made-to-measure couture at our atelier in Salamanca or Madrid. Personalised guidance, hand-picked fabrics, and the same care in every single piece.

resenas.texto: I found the perfect dress for my sister's wedding. The service was exquisite from start to finish.
Made-to-measure tailoring makes all the difference. You can feel it in every stitch.
Warm, honest advice — I've never felt so listened to in a store.
Exceptional quality and a service that makes you feel unique.
I'd come back without hesitation. Fely Campo understands what a woman needs.
